title: STARTEX — Thursday 13:00, Great Plains Crisis Network

fields.location: Great Plains Crisis Network 988 crisis center, Lincoln, Nebraska
fields.load: Normal Thursday forecast: about 520 calls, 140 texts and 90 chats a day. Every queue reads OK at 13:00.
fields.staffing: 16 counselors on the floor (9 calls, 7 texts and chats) and 2 shift supervisors. Calvin Whitehorse and 14 counselors arrive at 14:00.
fields.narration: Content notice: this exercise includes fictional material about people in distress and the deaths of young people. It uses no method detail and no caller stories. Anyone may step out at any time, and our wellbeing contact, Dr. Anneliese Park, is in the room. If two or more people leave, we stop. EXERCISE, EXERCISE, EXERCISE. It is 13:00 on Thursday, 12 March 2026, at the Great Plains Crisis Network in Lincoln. The day shift is back from lunch, both supervisors are at the raised desks and Priyanka Venkat is surge commander. Since about 12:50, local radio and social feeds have been carrying a Nebraska State Patrol report, issued at 12:10, of a collision between a school bus and a truck on a county road near Ellery Ridge.

status.name: 988 call queue
status.note: OK. Target is 90% answered within 120 seconds, measured every 15 minutes. 9 counselors are on calls.

status.name: 988 text queue
status.note: OK. Texts and chats share 7 counselors.

status.name: Telephony and text platform
status.note: Normal operations. The secondary carrier route is on standby.

status.name: Surge level
status.note: Level 1, normal operations. Priyanka Venkat is surge commander.

status.name: Staffing
status.note: Day shift follows Tamsin Reyes's Thursday forecast. Calvin Whitehorse and 14 counselors are due at 14:00.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before you read, check that Dr. Anneliese Park is in the room and that every participant has heard the step-out rule. Count anyone who leaves. If two people leave, stop play. At the hot wash, ask each person to name one thing that helped them stay steady.
fields.scenarioTitle: Two Intervals Behind — 988 Surge, Backup Routing & Safe Messaging

instructorNote: This card opens play, sets up the safeguards and shows a normal operating position just before the surge. Watch for every player to confirm their role and the safeguards, and for the surge commander to say who is watching the platform's own report as well as the wall board.
